domain-information: A receptionist registers a new patient and collects their medical details for admission.
A receptionist schedules an appointment for a patient.
A receptionist updates patient records when appointments are confirmed or rescheduled.
A patient provides medical history and symptoms during registration.
A patient checks in at the reception before seeing the assigned doctor.
A patient requests an appointment after treatment.
A doctor reviews the patient’s medical record before consultation.
A doctor diagnoses the patient and prescribes medication.
A doctor requests lab tests and reviews test results to confirm the diagnosis.
A lab worker receives a lab test request.
A lab worker sends the test results to a doctor.
A nurse assists a doctor during an appointment.
A nurse monitors patient vital signs and updates the patient record.
A nurse administers prescribed medication to patients according to the prescription.
A pharmacist receives prescriptions from doctors and prepares the required medication.
A pharmacist updates the medication inventory after dispensing drugs to patients.

domain objects.name: Receptionist
domain objects.description: Handles patient registration, appointments, and record updates.

domain objects.name: Registration
domain objects.description: Process of recording patient details for admission or visit.

domain objects.name: Patient
domain objects.description: Person receiving medical care or treatment.

domain objects.name: Patient Record
domain objects.description: Collection of a patient’s medical history and current health data.

domain objects.name: Medical History
domain objects.description: Information about past illnesses and treatments.

domain objects.name: Symptoms
domain objects.description: Patient-reported signs of illness or discomfort.

domain objects.name: Appointment
domain objects.description: Scheduled meeting between a patient and a doctor.

domain objects.name: Doctor
domain objects.description: Diagnoses patients, prescribes treatment, and requests tests.

domain objects.name: Diagnosis
domain objects.description: Result of medical evaluation identifying patient’s condition.

domain objects.name: Prescription
domain objects.description: Doctor’s order for medication or therapy.

domain objects.name: Medication
domain objects.description: Drug prescribed to treat a patient’s condition.

domain objects.name: Lab Worker
domain objects.description: Performs tests and prepares lab results for doctors.

domain objects.name: Lab Test Request
domain objects.description: Request from a doctor for lab analysis or testing.

domain objects.name: Test Result
domain objects.description: Outcome of lab test used for diagnosis confirmation.

domain objects.name: Nurse
domain objects.description: Assists doctors, monitors patients, and gives medication.

domain objects.name: Medication Inventory
domain objects.description: Stock record of available drugs in pharmacy.

associations.description: Receptionist starts registration for new patient
Doctor reviews and updates patient record
Doctor creates diagnosis for patient condition
Nurse updates patient record with observations
Lab worker receives lab test request
